profile.headline: Software Engineer | Designing & Implementing Microservice Solutions with Java
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 10 years of development experience, over 5 of those years spent designing and
scaling Java Spring microservices, event streaming systems, and web applications. I lead backend projects
that improve reliability, reduce downtime, and accelerate key user flows, and I partner closely with
cross-functional teams to drive quality, performance, and maintainable architectures.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved reliability and maintainability of core services by modernizing legacy applications and communication workflows, and simplifying integration points across sales, collections, and messaging systems.
• Enhanced scalability, visibility, and performance of legacy applications by refactoring them into modern Java Spring microservices, which lowered the frequency of software outages and reduced the lead time between discovery of an outage and its resolution.
 • Architected and implemented event streaming Java Spring microservices to automate outbound Sales and Collections calls to potential and current customers, which contributed to a 11% decline in customer delinquencies and a 7% increase in loan originations over the subsequent six month period.
 • Collaborated with UI development and Marketing teams to replace legacy Twilio SMS applications with a modern Java system utilizing Vonage SMS capabilities, which increased customer outreach and decreased SMS carrier costs.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Spring Reactive · Java · Apache Kafka · Software Architecture

positions.title: Travel
positions.description: Visited 23 major cities along the perimeter of the United States. Drove ~9500 miles over the course of 171 days. Along the way I developed new interests in photography, wildlife conservation, and writing.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Led development of the Tracer tool, a backend Java microservice that monitored API services and
reported user-defined anomalies to authorized parties for review and maintenance. The tool reduced
downtime of monitored API services by 10% compared to non-monitored services.

Integrated Apache Kafka, Redis, and a NoSQL datastore into the Tracer tool to consume and store
incoming REST operations for analysis and reporting.

Utilized JUnit, Postman, and Test-Driven Development principles to test and redesign Java mi-
croservices for improved maintainability.

Collaborated closely with other teams to deploy reliable software updates and releases using Docker, Git, Azure CI/CD Pipeline, and Kubernetes.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Framework · Continuous Integration (CI) · Java · Microsoft Azure · Continuous Delivery (CD) · Kubernetes

positions.title: Professional - Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of the Job Accommodation Portal, a web app that streamlined and accelerated
the Job Accommodations request process. The portal decreased the request process time by 15%.
Utilized the Angular framework and MySQL.

Designed the internal candidate application tool for DirecTv Latin America, a web application that
decreased job application time for job candidates. Utilized the Bootstrap 4 framework to improve
responsiveness across multiple devices.

positions.title: Engineer I
positions.description:
Developed and delivered the Work Distribution Tool, a web application that prioritized and grouped
similar job tickets for overnight technicians. The tool decreased drive time and increased ticket completion rate. Utilized the Angular Framework and MySQL.

Led the national rollout of the Work Distribution Tool, tracking production issues and providing
production support to overnight technicians and managers.

positions.title: Sr. Specialist - Technical Process/Quality
positions.description:
Developed and delivered the Real Estate Capital Planning Tool, a web application that managed the real estate capital budget for the AT&T Field Operations organization and prioritized real estate budget requests across the United States.

Developed and delivered the IEFS Project Portal , a full stack web application that tracked and prioritized software project requests for the IEFS National Developer team. The tool utilized the PHP Fat Free framework and Microsoft SQL.

Developed the Vehicle Safety Report , a PowerBI report that analyzes IEFS technician driving data and identifies geographical areas with poor driving behavior. 

Assisted in identifying and fixing defects in the Dispatch Learning Engine, an automated technician dispatching system for efficient dispatching of field technicians.

positions.title: Student Co-Op Technical l
positions.description: Developed the DISCS tool, a full stack web management system responsible for tracking of Central Office server inventory and storage of system backups, reducing the down time of servers during system malfunctions.

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed HifoCap, an Android application that wirelessly communicates with an electroencephalogram device and uploads EEG data to cloud storage.

Identified the challenges of developing long running applications on the Android operating system and provided effective solutions to these challenges.

Presented HifoCap application and overall results to judges at the 2016 Hispanic Engineer National Achievement Awards Conference (HENAAC) in Anaheim, CA.

Collaborated with the EEG device team to create software documentation dictating communication and data formats between the EEG device and HifoCap.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for fostering a cooperative and considerate educational community environment which contributes to the academic and personal growth and success of each resident.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Arlington
The University of Texas at El Paso

honors.title: HENAAC CyberSecurity Challenge 2nd Place, Novice Category
honors.description:
Participated in a team to solve sets of cyber security challenges in the areas of Packet Analysis,
Password Cracking, Steganography, Wireless Cracking, and Hidden Messages. Responsible for solving Password Cracking and Packet Analysis challenge sets.

honors.title: HackCU 2016 2nd Place
honors.description:
Collaborated in a team of 4 students to develop a software hardware combination that
increased availability of braille texts by converting PDF files to braille output. Team member responsible for development of Android application that stripped text from PDF files for wireless transmission to a mechanical braille device.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Colorado at Boulder · Apr 2016
